247 / 247 tests pass. Here's what was done:

**`back/app/engines/tick_bridge.py`:**
- Added `CompositionAuditRecord` dataclass (after `ResidualAdjustmentTrace`) — captures per-day T2/T4 collision metadata: `collision_detected`, `shared_target_id`, per-signal valence/absorption/target_id, `t2_residual_created`, `t4_residual_created`, `wake_chain_gate_open`
- Added `composition_audit_out: list[CompositionAuditRecord] | None = None` parameter to `simulate_day_bridged`
- Tracked `_t2_residual_created` via `len(ctx.new_residuals)` delta right after T2 apply
- Extracted the Phase 23 gate boolean into `_t4_wake_chain_gate_open` (replaces the inline `if` condition — identical logic, now named and observable)
- Tracked `_t4_residual_created` after T4 apply; emits one `CompositionAuditRecord` per day when audit is requested
- Handles T4=None case (no existing relationship) — emits record with `collision_detected=False`, `t4_*=None`

**`back/tests/test_t2_t4_composition_audit.py`** (14 tests):
- **Collision detection** (6 tests): confirms same `vega-001` target detected as collision, full signal metadata captured, no-collision when no relationship, confrontation records negative T4 valence, wake chain gate open when carried residual upgrades absorption, world_day field correctness
- **Downstream gate safety** (5 tests): T2+/T4+, T2+/T4−, T2neutral/T4−, bounded state values, bounded relationship values — all complete without exception
- **Wake chain depth bounded** (3 tests): 5 repeated identical calls produce identical finite residual count; 10 sequential days with residual carry never exceeds ceiling and decays to ≤5; gate stays closed without carried residual (self-limiting path)
